definitions.explanation: the time frame during which exams are held at schools and universities

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}{期間|きかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
{試験|しけん}{期間|きかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{混|こ}む→混む：02574_komu⟧。
examples.english: The library gets crowded during exam periods.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}{期間|きかん}{中|ちゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: I take a break from my part-time job during the exam period.

notes:
{試験|しけん}{期間|きかん} is a compound of ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ (exam) + ⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ (period). Refers to the designated time frame when exams are held at schools and universities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {試験|しけん}{期間|きかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter the exam period
- {試験|しけん}{期間|きかん}{中|ちゅう}: during the exam period
- {試験|しけん}{期間|きかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わる: for the exam period to end

JAPANESE ACADEMIC CALENDAR:
Japanese universities typically have two main exam periods:
- ⟦{前期|ぜんき}→前期：20651_zenki⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧: first semester exams (July-August)
- ⟦{後期|こうき}→後期：12603_kouki⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧: second semester exams (January-February)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{定期|ていき}{試験|しけん}→定期試験：24920_teikishiken⟧: regular scheduled exams
- ⟦{中間|ちゅうかん}{試験|しけん}→中間試験：06691_chuukanshiken⟧: midterm exams
- ⟦{期末|きまつ}{試験|しけん}→期末試験：06690_kimatsushiken⟧: final exams
- ⟦{追試|ついし}→追試：09971_tsuishi⟧: makeup exam
